knowledge.title: How lead verification works
knowledge.answer: Lead verification checks contact details and ownership signals, then labels each lead Verified, Pending or Unverified. Freshness is shown next to every lead.

knowledge.title: Filtering properties by tier
knowledge.answer: Open the Filters panel and set Property tier to Luxury. Results update immediately and can be saved as a view.

knowledge.title: Partner onboarding
knowledge.answer: Partners get a guided setup: profile, service areas, then payout details. You can resume it at any time from Settings.

knowledge.title: Creating a follow-up
knowledge.answer: Select a lead and choose Create follow-up. AVA can also create one for you; she always asks you to confirm first and only reports success once the backend confirms it.

knowledge.title: What the lead score means
knowledge.answer: The lead score ranks how promising a lead is, from 0 to 100. Higher scores are listed first in your results.
